assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Direction name: Arcane Material Refinement
Asset type: preview-only Summonlab skill-rarity frame comparison, 1488 x 1059 landscape.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and style anchor.

Primary request: Create a third independent interpretation of the approved material hierarchy, emphasizing nuanced surface finish and restrained arcane craft while keeping ornaments economical:
F = matte charcoal iron with hammered wear, a narrow undecorated rim and almost invisible rivets.
E = softly burnished aged bronze with brown-gold patina, one fine inset line and understated corner collars.
D = dark tempered blue steel with a subtle heat-treated cobalt sheen, crisp double bevel and tiny angular vertex cuts.
C = clean moonlit silver, brighter than D but not glowing, a precise stepped rim with one narrow geometric engraved channel.
B = keep the blackened amethyst frame; deepen the faceted purple mineral inset slightly, with no new outward ornament.
A = keep champagne electrum; use a gentle pearl-metal highlight, doubled inner rim, six delicate engraved spear-leaf accents, and the refined A crest.
S = preserve the existing saturated ceremonial antique-gold crown frame, ornament, material, and prominence as closely as possible.

Style/medium: elegant premium dark-fantasy game UI, realistic forged materials, fine engraving, subtle arcane undertones, pure black background.
Composition/framing: exact seven-tile 4-over-3 layout from Image 1; consistent hex size and spacing.

Text (verbatim):
"F" "Measured Cut" "NOVICE · LV 1"
"E" "Ember" "NOVICE · LV 3"
"D" "Parry" "INTERMEDIATE · LV 5"
"C" "Stone Skin" "INTERMEDIATE · LV 7"
"B" "Fireball" "EXPERT · LV 10"
"A" "Thousand Cuts" "EXPERT · LV 3"
"S" "Worldfire" "MASTER · LV 10"

Constraints: Change only the frame materials and named ornament details. Preserve icons, inner skill illustrations, text, lettering, font treatment, positions, proportions, and background. The material sequence must be visually obvious: dark iron → bronze → blue steel → silver → dark amethyst → champagne electrum → ornate gold.
Avoid: duplicate warm metals at F/D; duplicate silvers at E/C; orange or bronze D; flat gray D; bright white A; extra B filigree; modifying S; excessive bloom; altered text; new symbols; watermark.

Add a refined double inner rim plus small symmetrical engraved flourishes at the six vertices and immediately around the A medallion. F — Measured Cut — NOVICE · LV 1
E — Ember — NOVICE · LV 3
